# A large block in Live

Live lays the block the caret is in out as Markdown. A **table**, a *list* or a `fence` of
hundreds of lines is one block: open this in Live (E for the editor, Ctrl+/ for Live), click into the
middle of the table below and type. Each key should answer at once, at any length of block.

> A quote before the table, with a [link](https://example.com) and ==a mark==,
> so that the blocks around the large one are checked with it.
